input.summary: Learn both center-gate returns and keep controllable balls on your side. Hit the disappearing targets to raise the spinner to 5,000, collect flashing Egg Bonus, and use the final 30-second Unlimited Balls period for continuous scoring.

quickInfo.name: Game format
quickInfo.summary: Joust supports one-player or two-player play, and its configured normal-ball count determines when the timed finale begins.

quickInfo.name: Head-to-head play
quickInfo.summary: Each player controls two flippers while spinner gates send balls between the two ends.

quickInfo.name: Untimed Unlimited Balls
quickInfo.summary: A qualified disappearing-target lane can start a separate replacement-ball period under the installed rules.

quickInfo.name: Final Unlimited Balls
quickInfo.summary: After normal play, each player receives a 30-second replacement-ball scoring finale.

steps.text: Release the first ball when prompted. Watch both center spinner gates before committing to a shot.
Keep a controllable ball on your end while you learn which center shot transfers it to the other player.
Hit the first disappearing target to light the spinner at 1,000, then hit the second to raise it to 5,000.
Shoot the 5,000 spinner only when you accept the transfer to the other end.
Use numbered and Hunter rollovers, then collect a flashing Egg Bonus at the indicated left three-bank.
modeNotes: Egg Bonus: Hunter and numbered rollover progress lights the bank collect shown by the local display and lamps.

steps.text: When a target lane shows a qualifying value, shoot it and confirm Untimed Unlimited Balls before changing routes.
modeNotes: Untimed Unlimited Balls is separately qualified from the automatic 30-second finale. Its ending condition varies, so identify the installed behavior before changing routes.

steps.text: When normal play ends, use the 30-second Unlimited Balls finale to keep every available ball moving.
modeNotes: Unlimited Balls: Drained balls are replaced during the timed finale, which ends when its 30-second countdown expires.

steps.text: During the finale, favor the 5,000 spinner and lit Egg Bonus or target-bank collects until time ends.

fallback.title: Recovery: Local targets and Egg Bonus
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when center-gate shots give the opponent too much control.

steps.text: Keep the ball on your end.
Work one local three-bank at a time.
Use Hunter rollovers when the feed is natural.
Wait for Collect Egg Bonus to flash, then take its indicated bank.
Avoid the spinner until its value is useful.

alternatives.title: Position play: High-value spinner attack
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when the two disappearing targets are safe.

steps.text: Hit both disappearing targets and confirm 5,000 at the spinner.
Shoot through the spinner gate.
Prepare for a ball returning through either center gate.
Repeat only while 5,000 remains lit.

alternatives.title: One-player practice
alternatives.when: Use this before a match to learn both ends of the machine.

steps.text: Start a one-player game and release the first ball when prompted.
Control all four flippers.
Learn both center-gate feeds and raise the spinner value on each end.
Complete normal play on your side.
Keep scoring while the other player finishes remaining normal balls.
Enter the final 30-second Unlimited Balls period.
Use the 5,000 spinner and lit bank or Egg Bonus awards.
Continue until the countdown ends.
Joust has no separate mini-wizard or wizard mode.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper scoring lanes
playfieldReferences.description: The lanes controlled by the paired upper flippers.

playfieldReferences.label: Center spinner
playfieldReferences.description: The spinner used for repeatable transferred shots between players.

techniques.name: Dual-flipper lane change
techniques.instruction: Tap either flipper control only after you confirm which lamps move on the local game.

techniques.name: Spinner transfer
techniques.instruction: Use a center spinner shot after its value is raised because the ball moves to the other end.

techniques.name: Four-flipper practice
techniques.instruction: Use one-player mode to operate all four flippers and learn both center feeds.

cautions.issue: A center spinner shot sends the ball to the opponent's end.
cautions.response: Do not expect a normal return and watch for another ball coming through either gate.

cautions.issue: Two players shoot at the same time.
cautions.response: Watch both center gates while you control a local ball.

cautions.issue: A disappearing target can reset around a ball.
cautions.response: Stop play and call the tournament official if the ball remains stuck.

input.simpleOverview: Joust sends balls between two players through center spinner gates, then ends with a 30-second Unlimited Balls period. Keep a controllable ball on your side, raise the spinner to 5,000, and collect flashing Egg Bonus. During the finale, keep every available ball moving through the best lit awards.
input.overview: Joust sends balls between two players through center spinner gates, then ends with a 30-second Unlimited Balls period. Learn both spinner returns before sending a ball away, raise the spinner to 5,000, and collect the indicated bank when Egg Bonus flashes. Use the final 30 seconds for continuous spinner and bank scoring.
